_comment: Tier-2 for febio::rigid_body#0. Two wrong forms, two stages: a <rigid_bc> inside <Boundary> is caught at parse with 'tag "rigid_bc" (line N) : unrecognized tag'; a nodal <bc type="prescribed displacement"> on the rigid body's own nodes READS SUCCESSFULLY and only then fails with 'Rigid nodes cannot be prescribed.', 'Boundary condition N (push) failed to initialize' and 'Model initialization failed'. The read_success assertion on the second is the point — a wrapper that checks only the reader line believes that deck is fine. Positive control: the shipped template, unmodified, which reaches normal termination. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
